title: "get_abc_tax_genes"
output: html_document
date: "2026-02-04"
---

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
path_abc <- '/Volumes/krienen/atlases/allen-brain-cell-atlas/'
pth_tax <- file.path(path_abc, 'metadata/WMB-taxonomy/20231215/cl.df_CCN202307220.xlsx')
pth_gn  <- file.path(path_abc, 'metadata/WMB-10X/20231215/gene.csv')

# > cbind(readxl::excel_sheets(pth_tax))
#      [,1]                        
# [1,] "cluster_annotation"        
# [2,] "supertype_annotation"      
# [3,] "subclass_annotation"       
# [4,] "class_annotation"          
# [5,] "MERFISH_gene_panel"        
# [6,] "Column header explanation "

## only need the cluster table, it has the rest of the taxonomy in it
cl <- read_excel(pth_tax, "cluster_annotation")
mf <- read_excel(pth_tax, "MERFISH_gene_panel")
gn <- read.csv(pth_gn)

# > head(gn)
#      gene_identifier gene_symbol                                  name mapped_ncbi_identifier comment
# 1 ENSMUSG00000051951        Xkr4     X-linked Kx blood group related 4        NCBIGene:497097        
# 2 ENSMUSG00000089699      Gm1992                   predicted gene 1992                               
# 3 ENSMUSG00000102331     Gm19938                 predicted gene, 19938                               
# 4 ENSMUSG00000102343     Gm37381                 predicted gene, 37381                               
# 5 ENSMUSG00000025900         Rp1        retinitis pigmentosa 1 (human)         NCBIGene:19888        
# 6 ENSMUSG00000025902       Sox17 SRY (sex determining region Y)-box 17         NCBIGene:20671 
```

```{r}
c(
    cl$cluster_id_label,
    cl$supertype_label,
    cl$subclass_label,
    cl$class_label
) %>% 
    strsplit(" ") %>% 
    unlist %>% 
    unique %>% 
    intersect(gn$gene_symbol) ->
    abc_tax_genes

# > length(abc_tax_genes)
# [1] 194
```

only 194 genes, which is fewer than I thought (and there's like some chance of
a coincidental overlap of a taxonomy name and a gene name)

```{r}
write(
    abc_tax_genes, 
    '/Users/mike/Princeton Dropbox/Michael DeBerardine/DanTurner_MSA_figures/misc/gene_sets/abc_wmb_tax_genes/abc_tax_genes.txt'
)
```
